That means contacting a mentor early is not optional; it is the application. Budget far more time than a standard app, but the proposal itself is excellent practice for graduate fellowships later.

programs.name: NYSCF Summer Research Internship
programs.focus: Stem cell and neurodegeneration research in NYC.

eligibility.notes: Deadline is 5:00 p.m. ET.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED: Mar 15, 2027, program runs Jun 7 - Aug 13, 2027. Valuable as a LATE deadline, a real second chance if February brings rejections.

programs.name: Alzheimer's Disease Research Center summer research
programs.focus: Alzheimer's disease clinical and imaging research at a major NIA-funded center.
programs.notes: If the INSPIRE Alzheimer's angle is the real interest, the national network of NIA-funded ADRCs is the thing to mine. There are more than 30, and most take undergrads by direct arrangement rather than a posted program.

programs.name: Biological Sciences Division: summer research
programs.focus: Biomedical research across the Biological Sciences Division, with Comer Children's Hospital for pediatric projects.
programs.notes: CORRECTED: the Pritzker Summer Research Program page, with its 30 Nov 2026 deadline, is for the University of Chicago's own MEDICAL students, not undergraduates. Do not chase that date. UChicago is a Leadership Alliance member institution, so the SR-EIP application is the reliable undergraduate route in; this hub is the place to look for a direct lab contact. Comer Children's is the pediatric angle.

programs.name: Children's Mercy Research Institute training
programs.focus: Pediatric research with notable strength in genomic medicine and precision therapeutics.
programs.notes: Pairs geographically with Stowers, also in Kansas City, two solid programs in a city almost nobody applies to from the coasts.

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics Summer Internship
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research with Weill Cornell pediatrics faculty.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list: opens Dec 8.

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics research (Le Bonheur)
programs.org: UT Health Science Center / Le Bonheur Children's Hospital
programs.focus: Pediatric research at Le Bonheur, including a well-regarded neuroscience and epilepsy group.
programs.notes: Same city as St. Jude. If you are applying to POE anyway, a direct email here costs nothing, and the pediatric epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's lab on your list. Likely arranged by direct contact rather than a portal.

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics research opportunities (Riley Children's)
programs.org: Indiana University School of Medicine / Riley Children's Health
programs.focus: Pediatric research across IU's Department of Pediatrics at Riley Children's.
programs.notes: Third Indiana option alongside INSPIRE and the IU summer research program. One application trip, three shots, and INSPIRE was already on the original list.

programs.name: Education & training programs
programs.focus: Neurology and neurosurgery research at one of the largest dedicated neurological institutes in the world.
programs.notes: Strong clinical neuroscience exposure, which is harder to find than bench neuroscience. Pairs with Phoenix Children's for one city.

programs.name: Emergency Department Clinical Research Internship
programs.focus: Hands-on pediatric emergency medicine clinical research, patient enrollment and data collection in the ED.

eligibility.notes: Roughly 15 hours/week onsite during the fall-spring session.

programs.notes: CORRECTION: the posted cycle is a FALL-SPRING internship (Sept 13, 2026 - May 15, 2027) whose deadline was Aug 10, 2026 and has passed, not a summer program. 15 hours/week onsite, ten interns taken. Real pediatric emergency-medicine patient contact, which is rare and valuable, so it is worth emailing to ask whether a summer 2027 session runs and when it opens. Do not plan the summer around this one. Downtown DC, about an hour from Leesburg.

programs.name: NIA Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers: directory
programs.focus: The master directory of NIA-funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers.
programs.notes: Not a program: a hunting ground. Pick the three centers nearest you and email the education coordinator at each. Most do not advertise undergraduate slots but will take a strong student who asks. The single highest-leverage move for an Alzheimer's interest.

programs.name: Neuroscience & Cell Biology Summer Research
programs.org: Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School
programs.focus: Neuroscience and cell biology research in RWJMS labs.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list: opens Jan 2.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Pathways to Science: summer research database
programs.focus: The best free aggregator of funded undergraduate summer research programs, searchable by discipline and deadline.
programs.notes: Use this as a monthly sweep to catch programs this list does not have. Sort by deadline.

programs.name: Pediatric Epilepsy Research Internship (Loddenkemper Lab)
programs.focus: Pediatric epilepsy and EEG research in a single high-output lab.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list: opens Jan 23. Single-lab internship, a specific, direct email to the PI matters more here than a generic application.

programs.name: Pediatrics summer research (Benioff Children's)
programs.focus: Pediatric research across UCSF's Department of Pediatrics.
programs.notes: Often filled by direct faculty contact rather than a central application, see the cold-email template in materials/.

programs.name: Rebecca D. Considine Research Institute summer programs
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research at a mid-size children's hospital.
programs.notes: Genuine safety. Ohio now has five options on this list, Cincinnati, Nationwide, the two Case Western programs, Cleveland Clinic and this.

programs.name: Research & Innovation summer opportunities
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical and translational research, affiliated with UConn Health.
programs.notes: Close to Yale, so a New Haven / Hartford trip could cover both this and the Child Study Center. Smaller applicant pool than the big-name children's hospitals.

programs.name: Research Training & Internships
programs.focus: Multiple pediatric research internship tracks across the institute.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list: opens Dec 1. The landing page lists several distinct tracks. Pick the one that matches.

programs.name: Research and education programs
programs.focus: Northern Virginia's largest health system, with clinical and translational research including Inova Children's Hospital.
programs.notes: About 35 minutes from Leesburg, so no housing cost. You already worked in Fairfax at Privia, so you know the area and may have a contact who can point you at the right person. This is a hub page: the summer research listings sit under research and education, and a direct email is likely to work better than a portal.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Research opportunities
programs.org: George Washington University School of Medicine
programs.focus: Clinical and translational research in downtown DC, with ties to Children's National.
programs.notes: GW's pediatrics department is based at Children's National, so an email here can lead to the same place by another route.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Simmons Cancer Center education & training
programs.org: UT Southwestern Harold C. Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center
programs.focus: Cancer-focused summer research training at UT Southwestern.
programs.notes: Second UT Southwestern route alongside SURF, which is also an Amgen host, three paths into the same institution.

programs.name: Student Research Programs
programs.focus: Campus-level undergraduate research program listings.
programs.notes: The weakest entry on your list unless you have an ODU connection. This is a general campus page, not a competitive national program.

programs.name: Summer Research Program
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research, including a notable pediatric epilepsy and neurosciences group.
programs.notes: Their pediatric neurosciences/epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's epilepsy interest, a good direct-email target.

programs.name: Summer Research Training Program
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical and translational research across hospital departments.

eligibility.notes: Confirm current-cycle eligibility on the program page.

programs.notes: Pairs with Pitt's other summer programs: same city, one trip.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Programs: searchable database
programs.focus: The AAMC's own index of summer research programs at US medical schools, searchable by state and institution.
programs.notes: Complements Pathways to Science rather than duplicating it: this one is specifically medical schools, which is exactly the right slice. Worth a monthly sweep alongside the NSF REU portal.

programs.name: Summer education programs
programs.focus: Cancer research at the oldest cancer center in the United States.
programs.notes: Markedly less contested than MSK or Dana-Farber while still being an NCI comprehensive cancer center.

programs.name: Summer research
programs.org: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at Virginia Tech Carilion
programs.focus: Neuroscience-heavy institute with work on addiction, developmental neuroscience and human neuroimaging.
programs.notes: Not commutable from Leesburg, but a genuinely strong neuroscience institute in Virginia that very few people outside the state apply to. The human neuroimaging work is close to what you already do in the lab.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.focus: Medical school research across neuroscience and the Lombardi Comprehensive Cancer Center.
programs.notes: Roughly an hour from Leesburg. Lombardi is an NCI comprehensive cancer center, and the neuroscience department is strong. Hub page: look under education and training for the summer listings.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.org: University of Virginia School of Medicine
programs.focus: Biomedical research at Virginia's flagship medical school, including UVA Children's.
programs.notes: About two hours from Leesburg, so a weekend drive home rather than a commute. In-state and a strong pediatrics department.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Undergraduate Scholars / student programs
programs.focus: Neuroscience and imaging research at HHMI's dedicated research campus, with an unusually strong tools-and-methods culture.
programs.notes: Small and very selective. Best fit if you have any computational or imaging leaning. Housing on campus is typically included.

programs.name: Undergraduate research fellowships
programs.focus: Regeneration, aging and comparative biology at a small marine and biomedical research institute.
programs.notes: Same town as the Jackson Laboratory, so one Bar Harbor application trip covers both, and this one is far less contested than JAX.

programs.name: Winship Summer Scholars Research Program
programs.focus: Cancer research at Georgia's only NCI-designated comprehensive cancer center.
programs.notes: Second Emory route alongside SURE, and more specific. Emory also connects to Children's Healthcare of Atlanta for pediatric work.
